word.definition: Aerie refers to the nest of a bird (such as an eagle or hawk) built high up on a cliff or on the top of a mountain. It can also be used for a room or building built high up so that people inside can see things happening below them.

sports_fact.text: Jim Thorpe was stripped of his 1912 Olympic gold medals because he had been paid $25 a week to play minor league baseball — they were restored in 1983, 30 years after his death.

market.headline: Investors Don’t Want to Scrap Quarterly Reports. Companies Should Think Twice.
market.summary: Information is the lifeblood of the stock market, but regulators want to let companies provide less of it.

quote.text: The pendulum of the mind oscillates between sense and nonsense, not between right and wrong. The numinosum is dangerous because it lures men to extremes, so that a modest truth is regarded as the truth and a minor mistake is equated with fatal error.
quote.author: Carl Jung
